evidence.title: Preliminary Findings for Amazon Data Services significant Part 70 permit modification 141-48867-00642 and 141-48888-00642
evidence.excerpt: The technical support document says SBN100's address was clarified to 31100 Edison Road now that construction has begun.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of retrieved PDF response bytes
metadata.observation_date_basis: The official package does not state a publication date; published_at is preserved as null. The 2025-07-14 observation date uses the PDF CreationDate metadata.
metadata.location_precision: approximate point for the addressed SBN100 source
metadata.coordinate_basis: Approximate analyst placement for 31100 Edison Road; not a parcel boundary or individual-building coordinate.
metadata.status_scope: The IDEM technical support document explicitly states that construction has begun at the SBN100 source; the observation is dated to the PDF's 2025-07-14 creation date and is not asserted as a July 2026 completion or operating status.
metadata.address_scope: IDEM says Amazon Data Services did not change locations and that 31100 Edison Road is the accurate address for SBN100 after construction began; 55001 Larrison Boulevard is retained only as the source's prior address, not a second campus.
metadata.identity_guardrail: This input represents SBN100 only. It does not merge or assign SBN100's physical status to SBN201, SBN104, or any other New Carlisle facility.
metadata.other_facility_guardrail: The same package mentions SBN201 as a separate data center, but does not say construction has begun there. A separate Indiana design-release filing identifies SBN104 at 55250 Walnut Road, but a design release alone does not establish physical construction. Neither is imported here.
metadata.permit_guardrail: The package concerns a draft significant modification for additional emergency generators. The construction-status claim is limited to IDEM's factual address clarification for the existing SBN100 source, not the unissued generator modification.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: Generator power ratings, tank sizes, emissions limits, and equipment counts are not data-center grid load, gross facility load, critical IT load, PUE, annual energy, or building counts; no capacity is imported.
